calibration.search_policy: Used live targets have native crop/scale provenance and bounded current-client search regions. Input uses a fresh match through InputGuard, never preview coordinates. Iron-vein list search covers only its observed visible position; general scrolling is not implemented.
known_risks: The shared C badge worked in this run; other character portraits and UI scales have not been exercised.
Unused candidate sprites retain their original provenance and are not live input authority.
A wider iron-vein search encountered blank-area match peaks; the current narrow region does not support arbitrary scroll positions.
The independent character_life_skills page preserves the original processing skills page. Generic scrolling and filtered-bag totals remain unimplemented.

Product completion was observed after progress 9/10 disappeared and stable native idle; no explicit 10/10 frame was captured. Yield 46 is a same-scope recipe-material difference, not ten guaranteed drops or a verified warehouse total.
